name: media-scout-downloader
description: Local-first Manifest V3 extension for finding and saving browser-visible, authorized media with explicit privacy and compatibility boundaries.
author: Nouraldin Farge

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:fixtures
scripts.coverage: c8 --clean --all --include src/shared/validators.js --include src/shared/report-privacy.js --include src/shared/download-allow-list.js --include src/background/report-manager.js --reporter text --reporter json-summary --reporter html --check-coverage --per-file --lines 75 --statements 75 --functions 70 --branches 55 node test-harness/run-tests.mjs
scripts.coverage:diagnostic: c8 --clean --all --include src/shared/validators.js --include src/shared/report-privacy.js --include src/shared/download-allow-list.js --include src/background/media-detector.js --include src/background/download-strategies.js --include src/background/queue-manager.js --include src/background/report-manager.js --include src/background/tab-media-store.js --reporter text --reporter json-summary node test-harness/run-tests.mjs
scripts.performance: npm run performance:node && npm run performance:memory
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run syntax:check && npm run invariants:check && npm run coverage && npm run test:fixtures && npm run performance
